name: DMATRIX
title: DMATRIX — Offline, Hardware-Aware Agentic AI Platform
blurb: Teams in air-gapped or GPU-constrained environments can't use cloud LLMs. DMATRIX profiles the host hardware, classifies its runtime tier, auto-selects models that actually fit, and serves private chat with live telemetry entirely on-prem — from 72B AWQ models on GPU down to CPU-only GGUF.

name: MET---Model-Evaluation-Trust
title: MET — Model Evaluation & Trust
blurb: LLM leaderboards report false-precision point ranks. MET ships every score with a confidence interval and publishes rank *sets* — clustered bootstrap CIs, paired permutation tests, and a tamper-evident git-as-ledger provenance trail — all on a $0 infrastructure budget.

name: HESMA-scientific-tool
title: HESMA — High-Entropy Alloy Feature Calculator
blurb: Materials researchers need fast thermodynamic screening of high-entropy shape-memory alloys. Interactive periodic table in → phase, stability, and mechanical property predictions out, with PDF/Excel export. Built with guidance from DRDO lab researchers.

name: gominos-local-rag-agent
title: GOminos — Local RAG Review Agent
blurb: A fully local Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline that answers natural-language questions over restaurant review data — no cloud, no API keys, everything runs on your own machine.

name: Multi-Cuisine-Diet-Recipe-Studio
title: Multi-Cuisine Diet Recipe Studio
blurb: Turns whatever is in your fridge into diet-aware, multi-cuisine recipes with structured prep/cook/nutrition output — Gemini calls run server-side so the API key never reaches the browser.

name: genai-rag-research-tool
title: GenAI RAG Research Assistant
blurb: Research assistant that answers questions across URLs, text PDFs, and *scanned* PDFs — OCR-powered ingestion plus FAISS semantic search, with local (Ollama) or hosted (Groq) LLM backends.

name: ThermX
title: ThermX — Thermal Panel Control Station
blurb: Desktop GUI for controlling and monitoring an Arduino-based hexagonal thermal panel array in real time from a React interface.

name: FieldMind
title: FieldMind — Precision Agriculture Platform
blurb: A precision-agriculture platform bringing data-driven decisions to field management.

name: SiFt-Locale
title: SiFt Locale
blurb: Air-gapped resume screening — a local LLM turns resume piles into a structured, chattable candidate table. No internet, no APIs, no data leaves the room.
